Subject: MAP: stakeholder owners, milestones & dependencies (draft)

Hi Jordan / Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment on goals and the initial timeline. As promised, attached is a first pass at a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Redwood <> Acme pilot. Key pieces in v1 attached: milestone list, suggested owners (high-level), target close date, and explicit dependencies.

Please review the short items below and confirm by EOD Friday if possible so we can lock owners and get legal looped. Specific asks: 
- Confirm the economic buyer — who will sign the PO?
- Confirm the security owner and legal owner at Acme (names + emails) so we can route the questionnaire/controls evidence.
- Confirm the engineering lead who will own technical integration workstreams (SOW / access / test data).
- Call out any additional blockers (procurement timelines, internal change freezes, external vendor approvals).

Quick highlights from the draft MAP (see sheet "Milestones"):
- Pilot kickoff: target 2027-05-10 (Redwood action: provisioning sandbox and onboarding doc)
- Integration & test: 3 weeks (Acme eng to provide sample data / env access)
- SOC2 controls review + data handling: Redwood to provide evidence pack (dependency: Acme security review)
- Legal review & PO: target 2027-05-31

Attachments: 20270502-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP milestones + RACI), acme-risk-matrix.pdf (security notes).

I captured suggested owners in column C of the MAP; I set placeholders where we didn't confirm names on the call. I put Ben and Marissa as Redwood internal leads for commercial & eng respectively. If those assignments are wrong, let me know.

Thanks — I can update the doc in real time if you prefer to walk through it on a short call.

Best,
Priya

Thanks Priya — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Samantha Cruz (CFO) — she will own PO/term signoff.
- Security owner: Alex Patel (Lead, Cloud Security) — alex.patel@acme.com. He will need the SOC2 + data flow diagrams.
- Legal owner: Paul Howard (Procurement/Legal liaison) — paul.howard@acme.com. He typically takes the first pass on redlines; procurement runs parallel for PO.
- Engineering lead: I want to put our Senior Manager, Platform Eng (Samantha will confirm the name tomorrow) — for now assume Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com> as the placeholder.

On dependencies: procurement at Acme has a monthly PO cycle that closes around the 28th of each month — if we want a May 31 signoff we need contracts in review by week of May 10. That means Redwood should share the commercial SOW + any standard T&Cs by Friday May 7.

I'll review the MAP v1 and add inline comments on Drive after this. Also copying Alex and Paul in a separate thread once we have confirmation from Samantha.

Cheers,
Jordan

Jordan / Samantha / Alex / Paul —

Thanks for the quick turn. I updated the MAP to v2 (attached) based on Jordan and Ben's notes and assumed owners below: 

- Economic buyer: Samantha Cruz (CFO, Acme) — will own PO signoff and commercial approval.
- Security owner: Alex Patel (Lead, Cloud Security, Acme) — will own the controls review; Redwood to deliver SOC2 package + data flow diagrams by 2027-05-07.
- Legal owner: Paul Howard (Procurement/Legal liaison, Acme) — legal review target complete 2027-05-24.

Updated milestones & dependencies (summary):
- SOW & T&Cs shared (Redwood) — target 2027-05-07 (dependency: internal Redwood legal review)
- Pilot sandbox provisioned (Redwood Eng) — target 2027-05-10 (dependency: sample data access from Acme)
- Security review completed (Acme Security) — target 2027-05-17 (dependency: SOC2 + diagrams delivered)
- Legal & procurement signoff (Acme) — target 2027-05-31 (dependency: SOW & contract in review by 2027-05-10)

Next steps / asks:
1) Alex / Paul — please confirm you accept ownership and the timelines noted above. If any dates are infeasible, flag the item with an alternative.
2) Samantha / Jordan — confirm the target close (we currently have 2027-05-31; if procurement needs a later cycle we will adjust).
3) Ben / Marissa — I'll add the provisioning tasks and estimated hours into the MAP and share v3 after Alex confirms access requirements.

I've attached v2 (20270502-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx) and updated the RACI sheet with bolded owners. For visibility, I'm also linking the Drive doc here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1ExampleMAP
